quotes.name: Elliott Crane
quotes.quote: The conversation around rent hikes and neighborhood changes in Uptown is real, and it's on my mind. I've heard residents openly discussing plans to leave because of the hikes. As their representative, it creates accountability for me to ensure that we're doing everything we can to support the community. I want to see us focus on maintaining the vitality of our commercial corridors like Piedmont Avenue, ensuring basic city services are effective, and being transparent about our fiscal oversight.
